1. Use a non-stick skillet

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided suggestions on how to store leftovers from the Chicken Fajitas recipe:  
1. Refrigerate cooked chicken in airtight containers within 2 hours.  
2. Freeze cooked chicken in portions for up to 4 months.  
3. Refrigerate or freeze cooked vegetables.  
4. Re-purpose leftovers for new meals.
